properties.name: surfaceClass
properties.description:
Classes for the inset surface (where children live) — padding, layout,
background overrides. The `class` prop styles the outer Panel frame.

properties.name: dismissLayer
properties.description:
Render the full-viewport dismiss layer under the panel while open.
Defaults to `true`. Set to `false` for triggers that must stay
clickable while open (e.g. an input-style combobox trigger);
outside pointer dismissal still applies via `allowClickOutside`.

properties.name: focusTrap
properties.description: Trap Tab focus inside the panel while open. Defaults to `true`.

properties.name: lockScroll
properties.description: Lock document scrolling while the panel is open. Defaults to `true`.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Trigger style -- matches Button variants. Defaults to outlined.
